en.hero_title: Joyful Charades & Pantomime for the Whole Family
en.hero_subtitle: No more awkward silence, lost paper slips, or timer disputes. PantoMeGo brings pure family laughter to your living room with a random roulette wheel, secret whisper cards, and playful countdowns!
en.hero_price_tag: Cheaper than an ice cream scoop • One-time purchase, no subscription
en.slide1_desc: A single tap randomly picks the next delightful animal or role!
en.slide2_cue_text: "Tiptoe silently like soft paws and wash your face with your hands!"
en.slide3_desc: Ticking sound in the final 5s and upbeat party horn finish!
en.slide4_desc: Chimes and confetti shower reward every successful guess!
en.dynamo_subtitle: Parents know the drill: the idea sounds lovely, but round one brings hesitation and tears. PantoMeGo solves every hurdle with joyful ease.
en.problem_1_d: “I don't know what to do!” – Kids freeze under pressure and the fun stops.
en.problem_2_d: Non-readers can't decipher slips of paper or blurt out the answer accidentally.
en.problem_3_d: “That wasn't fair!” – Stopwatch disagreements quickly sour the evening.
en.solution_1_d: One tap spins a guaranteed age-appropriate term in seconds.
en.solution_2_d: Parents glance at the word and hint, whispering cues into toddler ears. Zero reading anxiety!
en.solution_3_d: Vibrant visual ring (30s, 60s, 90s) and victory chimes celebrate shared triumphs.
en.ped_subtitle: PantoMeGo isn't passive screen swiping. It's the catalyst for physical movement, nonverbal expression, and heartwarming family connection.
en.ped_1_d: Children jump like frogs, stomp like elephants, or balance like surfers. Naturally trains coordination and spatial awareness.
en.ped_2_d: Conveying actions and emotions without words sharpens facial expressions, body language, and empathy.
en.ped_3_d: Concrete acting cues (“Act like you are holding a frying pan”) make toddlers feel confident and proud.
en.steps_subtitle: No manual to read. Start your very first charade round in under ten seconds.
en.step_1_d: Tap the dice. The vibrant wheel selects a secret animal or profession.
en.step_2_d: Mom or Dad quietly whispers the secret term and playful acting hint into the child's ear.
en.step_3_d: The color timer rings (30s, 60s, or 90s). Ticking audio in the final 5 seconds builds excitement!
en.step_4_d: Got it! Hit the button: joyful fanfare sounds and confetti rains down.
en.modes_subtitle: Kids want to hold the phone themselves, while parents worry about screen time. PantoMeGo solves the dilemma brilliantly.
en.mode_1_d: The smartphone stays safely in parents' hands. The secret whisper card provides child-friendly acting tips directly into the ear.

en.mode_1_f2: ✓ Concrete gesture cues to whisper in their ear
en.mode_1_f3: ✓ Full control over round length & categories
en.mode_2_d: Young schoolers proudly hold the device themselves. Big fonts, one secret tip – and an instant prompt to put the phone down!

en.mode_2_f2: ✓ 'Put phone down & act!' cue as soon as round starts
en.tiers_subtitle: From toddlers to pre-teens: concepts grow alongside your child's developmental milestones.
en.tier_1_d: Familiar animals and household roles with simple, recognizable gestures and toddler cues.
en.tier_2_d: Dynamic creatures, fairy-tale figures, and professions that inspire lively storytelling.
en.tier_3_d: Exciting multi-step challenges for school-aged kids to test deduction and creativity.
en.tier_1_quote: “Tiptoe quietly like a kitten and groom your whiskers!”
en.tier_2_quote: “Pull a white rabbit out of an imaginary top hat!”
en.tier_3_quote: “Peer through a magnifying glass and follow secret footprints!”
